course.title: EcoSort
course.intro: Learn how to sort everyday waste into the right bin.

bins.name: Compost
bins.description: Food and plant waste that can break down naturally.

bins.name: Landfill
bins.description: Items that cannot be recycled or composted in this game.

items.name: Plastic bottle
items.hint: Clean plastic bottles can be recycled.

items.name: Banana peel
items.hint: Fruit peels can break down in compost.

items.name: Chip packet
items.hint: This packet goes in landfill in this example.

items.name: Broken toy
items.hint: This toy goes in landfill in this simple game.

items.name: Used tissue
items.hint: Used tissues go in landfill in this example.

quiz.question: Where should a clean soda can go?

feedback.correct: Correct! A clean soda can can be recycled.
feedback.incorrect: Remember: metal cans can be recycled.

quiz.question: Where should a banana peel go?

feedback.correct: Correct! Fruit peels can be composted.
feedback.incorrect: Fruit peels are food waste, so choose compost.

quiz.question: Where should a chip packet go in this game?

feedback.incorrect: In this simple game, choose landfill.
